presentationTable.name: Claims Metrics
presentationTable.description: Tracks claims submissions, approvals, denials, pending counts, monetary totals and denial ratio. Grain: service month, district, coverage program and claim type. Counts and amounts use SUM; Claims Denial Ratio divides aggregated denied by aggregated submitted and returns NULL for a zero denominator. Currency is unspecified. Claims operations only; no patient-level clinical outcomes.

presentationColumns.name: Claims Denial Ratio
presentationColumns.description: Claims denial ratio is aggregated denied claims divided by aggregated submitted claims. Returns NULL if no claims were submitted. Stored as a fraction; format as a percentage. Do not sum or average stored segment rates.
